product_metadata.title: Willa Flare Electric Pressure Magnetic Cooker Cook Times Cheat Sheet (Large Font) - Reference Chart Compatible with Instant Pot and InstaPot + Perfect Hard-Boiled Egg Method, Cooking Tips and Tricks
features: NOW WITH BIGGER, EASIER-TO-READ FONT: We heard you loud and clear: You loved our best-selling cooking times fridge magnet, but the font was just too small. Now, our new-and-improved electric pressure cooker cheat sheet is back and better than ever! With bigger font for easy reading and a brand new 8.5" x 5" spiral bound chart design, cheating your way to perfectly cooked meals has never felt better (and been so EASY)!

SPIRAL BOUND CHART DESIGN SAVES SPACE: Unlike pressure cooker decals that cram tons of tiny text onto one huge guide, the Willa Flare magnetic flip chart is a space-saving machine with multiple, flippable pages. Plus, it’s printed on high-quality glossy cardstock, so messy foods like spaghetti splatter and grease can easily be wiped off without warping. And did we mention? You get a whopping 109 ingredients with liquid AND frozen cook times, plus pressure and temp!

STRONG MAGNET + OPTIONAL HANGING HOOK: Sticks firm to any magnetic surface with an extra beefy magnet that keeps your cheat sheet in place and holding strong. Prefer to hang your kitchen stuff? We’ve included a handy hook so you can do just that! With so many places to stick or hang, you’ll never have to rummage through another drawer for your pressure cooker manual or look up cooking times and temperatures on a bacteria-ridden smartphone!

INCLUDES TIPS, TRICKS AND THE PERFECT EGG METHOD: Can’t remember what brushes work the most magic on your pressure cooker or which cleaning agent quickly removes pesky stains from your inner pot? Need an instant refresher on which electric cooker parts are dishwasher-safe and whether they should go on the top or bottom shelf? Our cheat sheet includes handy additional tips, tricks and cleaning techniques, PLUS how to effortlessly cook the perfect hard-boiled egg (not found in competitor charts)!

MODERN DESIGN FITS ANY KITCHEN: With attractive flat colors and a distraction-free design, you’ll love the way your flip chart looks with any decor. Easily find the food you’re looking for (whether it’s delectable crab legs, melt-in-your-mouth corned beef or family-fave corn on the cob) with convenient, color-coded category tabs. Know someone who’s crazy about kitchen tools and gadgets? It’s the perfect gift for home chefs, working moms and dads and parents of little ones who need to save time!
